title: Can You Buy Cars in GTA 6? No, You Steal Them 🚗 #Shorts
description:
There are no car dealerships in GTA 6. To own a car you steal it, then register it. Moses in Port Gellhorn registers untracked cars after a respray, and your first registration is free. After that, registration costs a few thousand dollars, and over $20,000 for high-end cars. Cars with Advanced Trackers alert the police if you slow down or stop, and you start with just one garage slot per character.

Sources: Gfinity Esports (GTA 6: How to Register Stolen Cars and Keep Them Permanently), Power Up Gaming (GTA 6: How to Steal, Sell, and Register Cars), HappyGamer (Can You Buy Cars in GTA 6?).
Images: Rockstar Games (An Extended Look / official trailers).
